segments.text: If the invisible man has an invisibility cloak,
and Batman has a full bodysuit and bat mask,
the men of the Republic of Korea have their military uniforms.
I have a lot of cases today.
No matter how mild mannered a man may be,
once he puts on his uniform, he becomes a beast.
Sunbaenim, please gather around.
In a little bit, in a little bit.
Sunbaenim, please gather around!
Alright.
Let's go.
Sunbaenim, please move to the left.
You move.
Are you a private?
When do you get out?
Please make your way to your respective groups.
Move?
It's hard enough to stand.
Once you've arrive at base, engage in shooting.
Then, return here after three hours.
Sunbaenims, please do not fill your bottles with soju.
And please do not cause trouble with those around you.
Why are you taking this so seriously?
You don't have a girlfriend, do you?
Please do not ask any personal questions.
If you keep continuing like this, you won't be able to leave.
Hey, you look right at home in the army.
You have the language down pat.
Sunbaenim, you should have brought your rifle!
I put it down because it was heavy.
That's mine.
When it's all over, give it back.
Her name is President Song.
President Song?
She's our biggest, greatest, and wealthiest client.
We need to get this contract.
We need your help.
You'll act as our company lawyer,
and you'll be our investor, alright?
Okay.
No problem.
Hey!
You're private Kim, aren't you?
Oh, you look completely different on the outside.
Did you get out of the army?
Yes, I did.
"I did"?
Look at this punk, how rude.
Attention!
Take your hands out!
At ease!
Attention!
One second.
Mom, over here!
Mom!
Hey!
Mom?
What mom?
It's "mother".
You rude little bastard.
At ease!
Attention!
Attention!
You bastard!
Hey!
What's wrong?
What's wrong?
Are you okay?
You're not hurt, right?
My feelings were hurt.
Your feelings?!
His feelings were hurt, you bastard!
In life, there are always reversals.
A private, will not always remain a private.
How dare you act that way to young master?
Episode 15
What are you thinking about?
About that guy from before?
Oh.
Oh?
My Yong Hwa, he's so handsome.
I guess you weren't joking when you said you were meeting younger men.
I still haven't given up hope.
Just because you have a goalkeeper, doesn't mean you can't score.
What did you say?
You meet younger girls, too.
You're five years older than me.
I may be five years older, but I'm still like a young boy.
In my eyes, you're just an old man.
By any chance, are you tired of me?
No, I really like Kim Do Jin.
Is this how you act around a person you really like?
Come on, we're both players.
Have you ever baited fish that you already caught?
So from now on, I hope you'll do your best to make my heart thump.
Wow.
The more I get to know you, the prettier you become to me.
What did you think of that kid before?
He was much younger than you.
Seo Yi Soo will decline.
Why?
He reminds me of someone when they are drunk.
Well, every time that happens, I have you to take care of me.
You fox...
Want to go see a movie?
Is there any movie you'd like to see?
You don't go to a theatre to see the movie.
You go because it's a dark place with four walls.
If you don't want to see the movie, we can just live together.
Really...
And I'll build a beautiful house on a grassy plain.
Oh my, really?
Really?
Is that what you'd think I say?
And why would you build a house there?
Land like that would cost a fortune.
There's a reason you went bankrupt three times.
You want to go home?
Why would we go home?
When we have a dark space enclosed by four walls?
Betty, let's go!
What is it?
Yoon wants us to come to his office together.
The kid is there right now.
He's Colin.
His name is Colin.
I know the English name must be unfamiliar to you.
But I didn't give him a Korean name.
I wanted you to give him one.
Eight years ago, when I appeared before you.
What are you talking about?
Eight years ago, you came to Korea to meet me?
Was I that insignificant to you?
If not, are you pretending you don't remember because of your guilt?
So that you can feel at ease?
Tell me in detail.
Did we meet and talk about him?
I didn't talk about Colin.
I just said I had someone I had to show you.
And you said we should meet the next day.
Truthfully, I had come with Colin that time, so that I could show you to him.
For the first time, Colin had asked me who his real father was.
But that next day, you didn't show.
Because you didn't come,
over three hours, Colin ate five waffles.
By any chance, was it during the summer?
Yeah.
About this time of the year.
It was the first time it happened.
It was when I didn't carry around my recorder.
What are you talking about?
Record?
How much more of a bastard are you going to make me into?
Is there anything else I should know?
Sorry.
That anger was directed towards me.
This is why I never wanted to show up before you.
I didn't want to cause you any trouble.
If you really didn't want to cause me any trouble,
then you shouldn't have run away in the beginning.
At that time, I...
...couldn't trust you.
I know this must be hard for you,
but everything you're feeling now,
I experienced nineteen years ago.
I endured it, accepted it, and made an attempt to become happy.
If you want me to, I'll take Colin back with me.
He doesn't seem like the type to listen.
That he takes after me.
Or maybe me.
It seems that a son...
isn't the only thing that's newly appeared in your life.
Let me introduce you two.
This here, is my former girlfriend, Kim Eun Hee.
And this, is Seo Yi Soo.
The person,
I've recently lost.
It's nice to meet you.
I don't know how this will sound to you,
but I was curious as to who you were.
It's regretful that we're meeting under such circumstances.
Unfortunately, in such circumstances,
I never imagined we'd greet each other so casually,
so although I feel bewildered,
I'll set one thing clear.
I'm not someone Do Jin lost,
but someone who was thrown away by Do Jin.
In such circumstances, I don't understand why that feels so unfair,
but in any case, it is.
I'll make my own acquaintances.
Please refrain from making such introductions in the future.
Let's go in.
Yoon is waiting.
You didn't trust me?
Don't misunderstand.
I did it.
I didn't want to keep asking stupid questions of Do Jin.
I'm sorry if we hurt you.
I understand.
Colin is your son.
I know.
Colin came with a strand of your hair,
so I showed him the results.
He looked at it for a long time,
and asked, "Does this ahjusshi have a lot of money?"
Can I leave first?
I'm going to have to meet him and have a talk.
We should have dinner sometime.
Let's get drinks instead.
Next time, when I come to Korea again with good news.
It was good to see you.
Me too, be careful.
I'll call you.
What are you going to do now?
About your son.
When you first learn how to ride a bicycle, there's something they say.
Turn the handle in the direction you're falling,
even though you feel as if you should turn the other way.
Right now the only thing I can do, is that.
Turning the handle in the direction I'm falling.
A while ago, in the hallway, I ran into Teacher Seo.
I think she was coming to see you.
When she comes again next time,
no matter what she says, listen well.
If she cries, give her your handkerchief.
Wait until she's all done crying.
If she curses me, you do it too.
And if she happens to ask about me,
"he seemed sorry," tell that to her.
You didn't even eat anything, why coffee?
I feel so dazed.
You're going to get sick like this.
Today, I saw that woman.
Kim Eun Hee.
How?
She was with Kim Do Jin.
So?
You should've grabbed a handful of her hair or something.
What's the point?
Nothing would change.
You don't grab someone else's hair to change anything,
it's all a sign of your authority.
I have priority over this man, that's what you're stating.
Priority?
The moment I came face to face with her, I had already lost.
I blanked out, everything became white,
I don't even know what I said.
There was only one thought in my mind.
That woman, unlike me,
knows the twenty year old Kim Do Jin.
Must be nice.
You're curious about Kim Do Jin's past?
I'm more curious about Im Tae San's future.
What future?
It's only a month...
What are you talking about?
I'm going to lie down.
What does that woman look like?
What do you think made Tae San fall for her?
She's pretty, everything about her.
As if she was drawn by someone.
Why are all first loves so visually bland?
I know...
Who is it?
Me Ah Ri.
Teach, are you sick?
Where does it hurt?
My whole body.
Should I buy some medicine?
No.
Why?
Are you so old that medicine doesn't even work anymore?
I heard you met that ahjumma, what does she look like in real life?
It's the first time I felt jealousy towards a woman older than me.
You were jealous of Kim Hye Soo, too.
The second time.
Teach, should I teach you Do Jin-oppa's passcode to his house?
What would I do with that?
You have to catch them red-handed, you never know if that woman will be there.
You want me to be an accomplice or go by yourself?
I'll go with you.
If necessary, I'll snap a photo too.
Should I?
Really?
It's really 99.9%?
He's definitely Do Jin's son?
Yeah.
\99.9% sounds a lot more definitive than 100%.
A probably of 99.9%, something like that.
How can you make a comparison like that?
Why is the decibel so high?
Why?
What did he say now?
He's like that for no reason.
What's wrong with probability?
That's a good word.
And it's always in CFs.
What about Do Jin?
At the office.
I just wanted us three to discuss something,
so I told him I had an appointment.
What is it?
Nothing much.
Do Jin has been out of it lately, and we've now become uncles,
so shouldn't we buy Colin some clothes or something?
That's true.
I didn't even think of that.
But is it one item each or one for all three of us?
That's not what's important right now!
It is important!
At 19, looks and fashion are everything to him!
With your fashion senses, it won't do.
Is he you?
I wonder, why do I keep feeling that he resembles me?
Should I put my hope on that 0.1 percent?
Shut up, how about you grow up now?
Are you going to be like this in front of him too?
A 41 year old friend of his dad?
It's a bit too late for me to change, but don't worry.
It may be hard to believe, but I have a feeling I'm going to be a great uncle.
Trust me, you'll never become a good uncle.
Unless all three of us are with him, don't even come close to that kid.
Just tell him to come out.
But where should we meet?
Where do high schoolers go nowadays?
Over here, here.
Hi Colin!
Does he really like places like this?
I said he does.
Then shall we reserve a room and call a lady over?
So you're Do Jin's son.
Welcome.
A present from your uncles.
It'll be more comfortable for you to stay at the residency for the time being.
Do Jin...
I mean, your father,
also needs time to become an adult.
What do you think?
Are you happy with your dad?
Are you not happy with it?
It's been about twenty five years.
When's your birthday?
September 22.
A virgo...
Blood type?
AB.
Oh, AB.
What color do you like?
Why are you asking me all this?
A Virgo with blood type AB,
you're anticipating much love, care, and devotion.
Shall we formally introduce ourselves?
As men?
I'm your father's best friend,
a cappuccino-like man, Rok.
You probably know already, but I'm Im Tae San,
your father's coworker.
And I own quite a bit of shares.
I'm Choi Yoon.
Your father's roommate and his lawyer.
Attention, bow.
Hello.
Who's on duty this week?
Here.
Jong Eon and Chang Min?
Yes.
The hallway windows are dirty, take particular care when washing them.
Yes.
Kim Dong Hyub is absent again?
Choi Sang Hyun.
Find out where Dong Hyub is by lunchtime.
I don't know where he is.
No.
You have to know.
That's all.
Why aren't you coming out to school?
'Cause it's humiliating.
Did you really hit Sung Jae?
Yes.
And you made him transcribe?
Yes.
What time do you get off?
I'm nowhere near done.
I'll wait.
Why?
You said you hit him, and that you made him do the transcriptions.
We have to go apologize.
We'll apologize, and you should receive an apology for being hit.
It's fine.
We're even now anyway.
You're not even.
When an adult is angry at a child, hitting them is not the answer,
admonishing them is.
You should apologize for hitting him,
and it's only right that you receive an apology for being hit.
Rather than all this talk about what's right,
right now what's more urgent to me is earning money.
Are you really not going to come to school?
A man needs to graduate from high school at the very least.
I'm doing these part-time jobs so I can go to school.
If I want to go to school, I need to take the bus,
pay for lunch, buy sneakers, and eat ddukbokki with the kids.
If I don't do these part-time jobs, how can I attend school?
I'm going back in.
Hello?
Who...
did you say you were?
You were surprised that I called, right?
Yes.
I have a habit of doing things abruptly.
I kept thinking of you.
About what, exactly?
Did you two separate?
By any chance, did Kim Do Jin...
Do Jin doesn't know of this meeting.
His life has been shaken up because of Colin,
he's a bit frazzled right now.
About me, me and Do Jin,
and Do Jin's son,
you must have a million questions,
but you haven't been able to ask any of them to Do Jin, right?
Do you love Do Jin a lot?
Is that what you're curious about?
It's important.
Love always is.
Whether I love Do Jin or not,
I don't understand why that's important to you.
The door you're standing in front of right now,
is a place I also stood at in the past.
A long time ago, it was a door that I also opened.
A door that led me to a world that I couldn't have imagined.
No matter how much you love Do Jin,
my Colin is probably a difficult and burdensome existence to you.
Even though I'm his mother, that's also how I felt.
I don't know about Do Jin,
but twenty years ago,
I loved a man named Kim Do Jin,
and had his child.
I was young, bewildered.
And that's why I ran away.
The excuse in all this, is that I was young.
Do Jin really didn't know.
It's alright if you're worried about Colin,
but I hope you aren't worried about me, that's why I wanted to see you.
As you can see,
enough for me to age gracefully, I am someone's happy wife.
This is all I wanted to say to you.
Well, then, I'll be leaving first.
With what courage did you open that door?
I didn't have a choice,
because I'm a mother.
The twenty-two year old Kim Do Jin, also loved you.
I know that.
That's a good thing for Colin.
I have to continue until I have no strength left.
Then I'll become bald.
Then I'll leave you.
Don't.
Even if you have a belly I'll still like you.
I have a favor to ask.
Before I come to stop liking you,
don't not like me.
All right.
Then within this month, I will love Seo Yi Soo.
Wake up!
You have to eat breakfast.
I've been up since dawn, you can do that much for me.
Alright.
It's gross.
Your delicious rice is complete!
Stop bragging.
Why are you picking a fight with the rice cooker?
He has no humility in his voice.
Can't you eat with the other guy?
No.
Wow, the soup looks awesome.
Hot, hot.
Alright.
You didn't sleep?
I remember seeing the sun rise.
Do you remember what our teacher in high school often told us?
Just because you're late doesn't mean you should be absent.
All you need to do is get hit a few times as punishment.
Have strength.
We're still growing as middle-aged men.
There's still plenty of time for us to set our lives right.
He said he fell asleep after watching the sun rise again.
I think he's like that everyday now.
It's a relief that at least you're in that house.
What do we do about Do Jin?
They just became a couple.
It's not that they're not seeing each other, it's that they can't.
Do Jin is one thing, but what about Teacher Seo?
She's a regular at my shop.
Come on!
It's bothering me too!
Because of the situation, even though we're friends there's really nothing we can say.
No matter how much wisdom you have, this is difficult.
After nineteen years your son suddenly shows up,
what is there to say?
Should you congratulate him?
Or should we suggest that we throw him a first year birthday party?
You!
Why do you keep yelling at me?
Did I give birth to his son?
Plus, why is it a problem that they're not seeing each other?
We can just force them to see each other.
You think we don't know that?
But this isn't a typical lover's quarrel.
One of them has a child,
and the other is in distress over that child.
That's why we need to get involved.
We have the upper hand.
On the other side is the two of them, Do Jin and Ms. Seo.
And there are three of us.
Why does that matter?
Whatever you're doing, the side with more players has the advantage.
You get in touch with Ms. Seo, and you with Do Jin,
and bring them to my cafe.
You're running your business even in this situation?
Hey.
The place where Ms. Seo and Do Jin first met was in my shop.
A few days ago, they even kissed in front of my store, really deeply.
My late night employee called and reported it, asking if he should call the police.
That is worth reporting.
Alright, let's move!
Go, go!
Is the rainy season going to start?
The weather is really nice.
If the rainy season was going to start,
it would be cloudy.
Right.
I'm saying the weather is weird.
Is Kim Do Jin coming?
What?
No.
Yes.
This relationship is quite odd.
This may all be useless,
but I thought it was a necessary meeting.
Thank you.
I missed him a lot.
Oh!
You were here?
Hello, Yi Soo!
This is great, I wanted to sit near the window as well.
Oh, this table is near the window too.
It's okay if we join you, right?
Meeting like this is a work of fate.
Stop, she caught on.
What?
Oh, we're caught?
Well, then, since we're caught, you should talk.
Right...
talk.
Just think of it as a coincidence.
You shouldn't have come.
I knew that what Tae San wanted to talk about was you.
I have an important matter to attend to,
so I'll be leaving now.
Please, don't be like this, could we talk for just a moment?
Dong Hyub is here as well.
You have to receive his apology.
Do you really have nothing better to do?
How many times do I have to tell you that I have nothing to say?
If you have anything to say, say it to your lawyer!
I have no wish to see his face again!
I'm sorry, but when a child holds his hand out first,
it is the adult's responsibility to accept it.
If you could just open the door, we will go upstairs to you.
How about you stop?
Be quiet.
And you also have to apologize to Dong Hyub for hitting him.
What?
Apologize?
Who should apologize to whom?
He's a gangster, not a student!
You're the one who taught him wrong, so why are you making a fuss here?
Are you really going to make me call the police?
I acknowledge my wrongdoing, but he's still a student and...
I don't want to hear it, I don't want to hear it!
How dare you come here and cause a ruckus?
Teacher Seo?
Hello.
So it is you.
I thought I was mistaken.
You really...
Mrs. Jung?
I'm Park Min Sook from 102.
Could I see you on the ground floor?
Oh my, representative Park.
Why are you...
You'll find out what it's about when you come down.
You live here?
It's obvious where rich people in Chung Dam Dong live.
What's your name?
Say what you need to say, Teacher Seo.
You know her?
Speak after you've heard everything.
Thank you.
First of all, I apologize for what happened to Sung Jae.
Dong Hyub is also reflecting on his actions.
Aren't you going to apologize, nephew?
Nephew?
Nephew, what was your name again?
Kim Dong Hyub.
I'm sorry.
Is he really your nephew?
Will anything change if he isn't?
No, well...
I'll accept your apology, alright?
I also believe you should apologize for hitting him.
You should've told me.
Then my lawyer would've taken care of everything.
Why should a civil servant involve herself in such affairs?
As a tax-paying citizen, that disappoints me.
Should we ask you to apologize again?
What?
Since it's a matter between children, I'll retract the lawsuit.
And I'm sorry for hitting you.
Thank you.
Thank you for taking time out of your busy schedule.
It's nothing.
Well, then, I'll be going in.
Thank you for helping.
I didn't help you, I was paying my debts.
You remember, right?
At the residence.
Oh.
But this is a bit excessive.
I have a tendency to add on plenty of interest.
You must know Sung Jae's mother very well.
She's the one who knows me very well.
People with money don't face others with sincerity.
They face them with money.
My nephew looks like quite a troublemaker.
Did you take in what just happened?
What you just saw is the world you're going to enter,
and is the reason why people without money need to study.
Understand, nephew?
You, go.
Since you're here, shall we have a cup of tea together?
With me?
I heard about Do Jin.
Oh.
Right.
Are you alright?
If you're having a difficult time...
No.
I don't think I'm alright.
Though we haven't been dating long, he even asked me to move in with him...
No one did anything wrong, I know all that.
But will I be able to be happy,
with someone who is the father of someone else's child?
One day I think I can, and on another that I can't.
I can't seem to make a decision either way.
So you're unable to step forward or backwards.
But?
What?
On your face is written, "and in spite of all that..."
In spite...
of all that...
I still like that person.
Why aren't you saying anything?
I'm busy.
Why did you come?
Hurry and go.
I'm not busy, and I know why you came,
plus you're not going to leave just because I tell you to.
You're making me nervous.
I think I like you better when you're angry.
I'm leaving work.
Wait a second.
Could you give me your arm for a moment?
I won't use it long.
What is this?
It caught my eye while I was walking down the street,
don't feel burdened by it.
Well, then, I'll be leaving.
You.
Come here.
Im Me Ah Ri...
Woah, it's the same as mine!
No wonder it looked familiar.
People's preferences are so consistent, right?
Take it.
Since I bought it anyway, can't you just keep it on?
I won't wear mine, I'll take it off.
Im Me Ah Ri.
What?
I've known Tae San longer than you've lived your entire.
It's the same for all four of us.
And we're going to be there for each other for the rest of our lives.
Your thoughts now, what you want from me,
will destroy all that.
That's why this will never work.
You know what I'm saying.
Is a bracelet some kind of handcuff?
It's just an accessory.
Do Jin-oppa and Rok-oppa wear it too.
Did I ask you to take your wedding ring off or to buy me one?
I just though it would be nice,
if you could wear one thing that was a gift from me.
Fine!
Don't wear it!
Just throw it away then.
And another thing.
What?
Don't lapse into informal speech.
There's a seventeen year difference between us.
Be Mine.
I love you more.
I worry about you.
Till the end, I'll take responsibility for you.
Be mine.
I know you.
You saw me.
Till the end, I'll take responsibility for you.
I don't have a heart.
I don't have a heart.
So I can't feel pain.
I talk to myself everyday.
I cast a spell on myself.
But the tears keep falling.
Hurry and get down.
Now you're drinking during the day?
What kind of girl drinks night and day?
I told you not to come if you were going to get angry.
I'm not the only one drinking.
Hong Se Ra is drinking every day and night too.
Stop talking back.
Hurry and get your shoes on!
You punk...
Hey, Choi Yoon!
Oppa!
Because of you, Me Ah Ri is always drinking, crying,
falls asleep in front of the front door,
won't go to graduate school,
and works at that cafe in order to see you!
I really can't stand it.
I'm the one who's going to die from all this!
Me!
Why are you doing this to Yoon-oppa!
Don't do it!
Choi Yoon, are you really going to do this to me?
If you're going to continue this, friendship or not, I won't see you ever again!
Oppa!
Please, hang up, it's all my fault!
What the hell?
You scared me!
I told you, didn't I?
Don't make me force you on a plane.
Don't you dare do this again.
If you do, I'll call Yoon for real and repeat what I just said.
Follow me.
Se Ra-unni is at our house?
No, she's not.
Then why is her car in front of our house?
You don't need to know.
You're going to exchange Se Ra-unni's car?
Then can I use this car?
No!
Why?
It's not being used anyway, so why not?
I'm in front of your apartment.
Let's see each other.
I was thinking about it, and couldn't stand the unfairness of it all.
From the confession to the tearful separation, you've always had it your way.
And on top of that you lie.
Before I came to dislike you, you said you wouldn't dislike me.
"Then today it's so and tomorrow it will be too."
"The day after tomorrow and the day after that.
For the next month it will be."
"So at least for this month, you can feel at ease."
"Then within this month, I will love Seo Yi Soo."
You told me that in your own words!
I'm aware of just how serious of a situation you're in right now.
But I don't worry about you at all.
What's so great about a guy like you?
And yet I want to see you so much twelve times a day, I'm worried about me!
So the separation will be on my own terms.
From this moment on, when I call,
no matter what you're doing, come out.
The promise that before I come to dislike you, you wouldn't dislike me,
the promise that for at least a month you'd love Seo Yi Soo,
keep those promises.
Until I no longer want to see you,
until I stop thinking of you,
until we can separate,
wait, by my side.
I'll do it.
Whatever Seo Yi Soo wants.
I'm at a crosswalk in Gang Nam, come out.
I'm going to the bookstore.
I hope I can meet that person again...
"I like you," that person's answer...
I'm going to see a movie.
Sorry.
Let go.
You pushed me away even harder than this.
Is this the attitude you should have towards the object of your unrequited love?
A man with an unrequited love for you,
